name: Christine Macwater
original_name: クリスティーン・マクウォーター
source:
Christine is the kouhai of the group and has a black hole in her stomach. She is absurdly close to [url=/c1547]Kasumi[/url]. So when [url=/c10696]Kazuki[/url] enters the picture, saying she is displeased is an understatement. But because he treated her to yakisoba before this revelation, she understands he is not a bad person. Gin is not a native to the island and used to commonly travel with her parents. Her MP3 player is a treasured item and has songs of her homeland. Christine is considered a Beltina prodigy and her dance is solid but her instructor worries that she does not reveal much emotion.

[Edited from [url=http://verbalrubbish.oniichannoecchi.com/?p=4098&cpage=1#comment-107931]m3rryweather's review[/url]]
